import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { Flights, FlightsService } from 'src/app/services/flights.service'; import { UserHttpService } from 'src/app/user-http.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-flights', templateUrl: './flights.component.html', styleUrls: ['./flights.component.css'] }) export class FlightsComponent implements OnInit { flights: Flights[] = []; // Form per aggiungere nuovo volo newFlight: Partial = { _flightcode: '', route: '', aircraft: '', duration: 0, dataOra: '' // stringa per input datetime-local }; // Oggetti usati per la modifica dei voli, chiave = _flightcode editingFlights: { [flightcode: string]: Partial } = {}; constructor( private flightService: FlightsService, private us: UserHttpService ) {} ngOnInit() { this.loadFlights(); this.resetNewFlight(); } // Helper: converte ISO string o Date in stringa compatibile con datetime-local toDateTimeLocalString(dateInput: string | Date): string { const d = new Date(dateInput); const pad = (n: number) => n.toString().padStart(2, '0'); return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}T${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`; } loadFlights() { this.flightService.getFlights().subscribe({ next: (data) => { this.flights = data; // dataOra resta in formato ISO string }, error: (err) => { console.error('Errore caricamento voli:', err); } }); } resetNewFlight() { this.newFlight = { _flightcode: '', route: '', aircraft: '', duration: 0, dataOra: this.toDateTimeLocalString(new Date()) }; } addFlight() { if (!this.newFlight._flightcode || !this.newFlight.route || !this.newFlight.aircraft || !this.newFlight.dataOra) { alert('Compila tutti i campi richiesti.'); return; } const flightData: Flights = { _flightcode: this.newFlight._flightcode!, route: this.newFlight.route!, aircraft: this.newFlight.aircraft!, duration: this.newFlight.duration ?? 0, dataOra: new Date(this.newFlight.dataOra!).toISOString() }; this.flightService.addFlights(flightData).subscribe({ next: () => { alert('Volo aggiunto con successo.'); this.resetNewFlight(); this.loadFlights(); }, error: (err) => { console.error('Errore durante l\'aggiunta del volo:', err); alert('Errore durante l\'aggiunta del volo.'); } }); } deleteFlight(flight: Flights) { this.flightService.deleteFlights(flight._flightcode).subscribe({ next: () => { alert('Volo eliminato con successo.'); this.loadFlights(); }, error: (err) => { console.error('Errore durante la cancellazione del volo:', err); alert('Errore durante la cancellazione del volo.'); } }); } startEditing(flight: Flights) { this.editingFlights[flight._flightcode] = { ...flight, dataOra: this.toDateTimeLocalString(flight.dataOra) }; } cancelEditing(flightcode: string) { delete this.editingFlights[flightcode]; } saveFlightChanges(flightcode: string) { const editedFlight = this.editingFlights[flightcode]; if (!editedFlight) return; if (!editedFlight.route || !editedFlight.aircraft || !editedFlight.dataOra) { alert('Compila tutti i campi richiesti.'); return; } const updated: Flights = { _flightcode: flightcode, route: editedFlight.route!, aircraft: editedFlight.aircraft!, duration: editedFlight.duration ?? 0, dataOra: new Date(editedFlight.dataOra!).toISOString() }; this.flightService.updateFlights(flightcode, updated).subscribe({ next: () => { alert('Volo modificato con successo.'); delete this.editingFlights[flightcode]; this.loadFlights(); }, error: (err) => { console.error('Errore durante la modifica del volo:', err); alert('Errore modifica Volo.'); } }); } }
